name: classifier
description: Classify batches of text into your labels, tag multiple topics, count categories and review uncertain results. Public access needs no API key.

interface.longDescription: Classify up to 1,000 texts per call using your labels. Five classification tools cover single labels, multiple dimensions, multi-label tagging, category counts and uncertain answers. Confidence can be absent; do not invent a score. A second MCP server provides API documentation. Public access is keyless and subject to service limits. Workspace usage requires a workspace API key configured separately. Synchronous classification text, labels, instructions and results are retained for training and operator review by default. Set share_data: false to opt out; see the privacy policy. Directory availability depends on platform approval.
defaultPrompt: Sort these reviews into positive, negative and mixed, then count each.
